user.title: hOn control
user.description: Adds stop, pause and resume services for appliances on the hOn integration (gvigroux/hon). No settings needed.

abort.already_configured: hOn control is already set up.

stop_program.name: Stop program
stop_program.description: Sends the hOn stopProgram command to end the running cycle.

pause_program.name: Pause program
pause_program.description: Sends the hOn pauseProgram command to pause the running cycle.

resume_program.name: Resume program
resume_program.description: Sends the hOn resumeProgram command to resume a paused cycle.

list_commands.name: List commands
list_commands.description: Returns the hOn commands this appliance supports and their parameter names. Sends nothing to the appliance.
